title: Predicting the acute pancreatitis severity with multi-machine learning models: constructing an online prediction platform.
summary: Among 1,289 acute-pancreatitis patients, ten machine-learning models were trained after Random-Forest/LASSO feature selection to predict severe disease; LightGBM was interpreted with SHAP and PDP.
ai_technology: Among 1,289 acute-pancreatitis patients, ten machine-learning models were trained after Random-Forest/LASSO feature selection
organization: The Second Affiliated Hospital of Guilin Medical University

evidence.tested: LightGBM achieved AUC 0.9726 in training and 0.9301 in the 30% test set; calcium, WBC, alpha-HBDH and glucose were key features, but the single-center retrospective split is not independent prospective validation.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
